UPSSSC Computer Operator Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Computer Operator on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 12 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Computer Operator Recruitment 2026 will start from 07 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Computer Operator Recruitment 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 September 2026
  • Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
